description: Issue #182 (1), the other side of the same rule: the inference survives when a FILE grounds it. #310 consumes the gateway types #311 declares, and both name `src/payment/types.ts` — a fact about the plan rather than about word choice. The pair could not share a wave anyway (rule 2 of wave packing), so ordering it producer-first costs nothing, which is what the heuristic is for. The edge carries `basis: file_conflict` and its reason names the shared file, so a reviewer can tell it from an edge someone stated (`declared`) without opening either issue. Without this case, the suppression above would be indistinguishable from deleting the heuristic.
